scope: Fresh read-only source and retained-evidence review; no test, browser, build, job, or native replay was run in this lane.

verdict_A_functional_scope.prior_important_finding: ADDRESSED at the controlled DOM seam: current plus unexpected, duplicate, or old rows and extra cells no longer set current_row=true.
verdict_A_functional_scope.new_breakage: IMPORTANT: the exact-result shape does not match the recipe saved by the native D47 driver. NetworkTab.selectEvent resets extractKeyPath to []; the driver selects the response and saves without selecting a JsonTree path. The persisted key_path=[] makes rowsFromBody return the root object as one row. The current fixture response root is {events:[{eventName:'Canyon Frequency'}],document:'current'}, so TableView renders events and document headings with cells '[{"eventName":"Canyon Frequency"}]' and 'current'. The reader requires one eventName heading and a Canyon Frequency cell; it will reject this correct saved replay and time out.
verdict_A_functional_scope.native_extension_acceptance: UNVERIFIED: Chromium DOM fixture tests the reader with a hand-written eventName table; no new installed-extension replay or old callback delivery was observed. D47/T57 must remain open.

verdict_B_doctrine_quality.guard: The retained resource journals show admitted permissive-reader red (child exit 1), green2 (exit 0), and constant-success red (exit 1). The builder reports 5 pass/2 fail, 7 pass/0 fail, and 1 pass/6 fail respectively. These exercise real Chromium DOM, but the positive markup assumes the eventName column rather than the native saved root-row schema.
verdict_B_doctrine_quality.new_breakage_assessment: The stricter check is sound for its hand-written one-column markup, but it is a false negative for the actual saved fixture. No product source changed. Align the reader and real-DOM fixture with the saved root-row table, then prove a current marker plus arbitrary unexpected result still fails.

findings.title: Exact observer rejects the native driver's saved root-response table
findings.evidence: tests/browser/showcase-d47-document-lifecycle.mjs:398-409 selects a response and starts Save without a JsonTree path click. src/features/showcase/tabs/NetworkTab.tsx:73-77 initializes extractKeyPath=[] and :383-390 persists it. src/lib/data-pattern/run-interactive.ts:303-324 returns the root JSON object for an empty path. tests/fixtures/showcase-replay/serve.mjs:30-33 makes the current payload events=[{eventName:Canyon Frequency}], document=current; ResultPreview.tsx:204-240 renders headings events/document and cells '[{"eventName":"Canyon Frequency"}]'/'current'. tests/browser/showcase-d47-saved-result.mjs:23-29 requires only eventName/Canyon Frequency. The valid fixture markup in showcase-d47-saved-result.test.mjs:39 encodes the incorrect one-column shape.
findings.impact: The saved-terminal wait cannot pass on the expected correct replay, so the driver cannot establish D47/T57 acceptance.
findings.required_followup: Check the saved root-row table exactly in the observer and Chromium guard, retaining mixed-result refusal; native acceptance remains separate.
